scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:server: cd server && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd web && npm install && cd ../server && uv sync
scripts.check: npm --prefix web test && npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix web run build && cd server && uv run pytest -q
